sources.entry: calabash-launcher - iOS Calabash Launcher is a macOS app that helps you run and manage Calabash tests on your Mac.

summary.one_liner: Calabash Launcher is a macOS app for configuring, running and managing Calabash iOS tests through a graphical interface, plus an element inspector for the iOS simulator's view hierarchy.
summary.what_it_does: The Test Runner lets you pick a simulator or physical device, a language, Cucumber tags and other parameters instead of typing console commands, and shows console output. For physical devices you enter the device's IP and the app's bundle ID in a device configuration dialog. The Element Inspector displays the app's view hierarchy as a tree, with element query strings, and highlights elements on a visual representation of the device. Clicking an element shows its class, accessibility id and accessibility label. The inspector can also look up an element's localized strings by reading the project's .strings and .json files. On first launch you point the app at your Calabash test repository and optional Cucumber profile.
use_cases: Run Calabash iOS tests from a GUI instead of the terminal
Pick simulator, language and Cucumber tag for a test run
Run Calabash tests on a physical iOS device
Inspect iOS view hierarchy to find element queries
Look up accessibility id and label of a UI element
Find localized strings for UI elements in an app project
how_to_run: Clone the project to your Mac
Open the project in Xcode and add a developer team (personal team via Apple ID)
Build and run the project from Xcode
On first launch, provide the path to your Calabash test repository and optional Cucumber profile, then save
Restart the app and configure a test run
notable: Element Inspector syncs with the running simulator automatically every 5 seconds
Click an element in the inspector to get its class, accessibility id and label
Supports both simulators and physical devices
Reads localized strings from .strings and .json files in the project
Actively used at XING SE according to the README
caveats: Element Inspector is limited to iPhone 6, iPhone 7 and iPhone 8 simulators
Requires Xcode, Ruby, Bundler and calabash-ios installed, and bundle exec calabash-ios console must work from the terminal
Needs an Apple developer team configured in Xcode before building
